description: Patch releases of Jellyfin are deliberately not automerged: v10.11.10 was a patch that added two EF Core schema migrations (AddNormalizedUsername, AddUniqueNormalizedUsernameIndex) plus a data routine, and Jellyfin applies those forward-only against the operator's library database on the next restart. A Molecule run that installs a fresh Jellyfin structurally cannot see that risk, so every version bump here stays a reviewed pull request.

The rule below is what keeps Renovate pointed at Jellyfin at all: LinuxServer publishes 12458 tags for this image, and while strict semver already discards the arch-prefixed and -lsNN flavours, it still accepts the date-based tags the image carried in 2020-2021. Those sort above every real 10.x release.

packageRules.description: Ignore the date-based versioning scheme (YYYY.MM.DD) this image used until December 2021; without this, 2021.12.16 outranks every real Jellyfin release
